notes.title: [v.1.3.9] Patch Notes | New stage & New aiming mode!
notes.content:
[v.1.3.9] Patch Notes
[h1]⭐ Added Content & New Features
[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new devil plant-themed stage has been added, featuring new enemies and an H-scene!
[*] New player aiming mode: Cursor Aim – Now you can attack in the direction of your cursor!
[list]

You can still switch to the old aiming mode by pressing:

[*] Tab (Keyboard)
[*] Triangle (PS)
[*] Y (Xbox)
[/list][/list]
We hope you enjoy the new update! Let us know your thoughts. 😊❤️


— Kumotori

notes.title: [v1.2.8.1] Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]⚙️Bug Fixes & Improvements [/h2] 
- Fixed an issue where players did not receive achievements after defeating the final boss.  
- Improved Joy controller responsiveness for smoother player movement.  

[h2]❤️Gameplay Adjustments  [/h2]
- Reduced player hitbox size for better maneuverability.  
- Lowered boss health to balance difficulty.  

If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out! 😊  
— Kumotori

notes.content:

- Joy controller stick drift
- WASD on keyboard able to control cursor position
